name: Copy Field
tagline: A text column with a copy-to-clipboard button and a confirmation.
summary:
Adds a copy button to a text column, for the values people copy out of a form and are not allowed to edit: a case reference, an account number, a correlation id. A read-only field keeps its button.

- The confirmation is announced to screen readers, not only shown
- A copy that fails says so, rather than a button that quietly does nothing

presets.name: Default
presets.description: A reference number ready to copy. Press the button to see the confirmation.

presets.name: Nothing to copy
presets.description: An empty column. The button is disabled, because a button that copies an empty string is a button that lies about having done something.

presets.name: A long value
presets.description: The field shrinks and the button holds its size, which is the layout a narrow canvas screen actually produces.
